items.claim: CFO 表示約 90% 業務來自雲端，並稱不再是傳統週期而是長期成長業務
items.quote: 90% of our business is with the cloud
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 客戶要求簽到 2030、2031 年的長約，但尚未簽署
items.quote: Customers are asking to sign LTAs all the way till 2030 and
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 被問及 AI 基建消化期，CFO 稱目前看不到消化
items.quote: So currently, we don't see a digestion.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱未來 5 年 exabyte 需求年複合成長率大於 25%，目前供給無法超過 25%
items.quote: We can't supply more than 25% right now year-over-year
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱營收受供給而非需求限制
items.quote: my revenue is not gated by the demand, my revenue is gated
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明 FY26 exabyte 供給成長約 25%，其中一季為 34%，目前約 22%-23%
items.quote: we grew exabyte on or about 25% year-over-year
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱目前處於兩個產品轉換之間，並列出 ePMR 40TB、HAMR 44TB、50TB+ 三個轉換
items.quote: We are now somewhat in between the next product transitions
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱 80% 資料存於 HDD，並認為高效能 HDD 可侵蝕快閃記憶體領域，KV caching 是機會之一
items.quote: KV caching is one of the opportunities out there.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱每 TB 價格兩季前年增 9%、上季年增 18-19%，仍有上升空間
items.quote: Last quarter was up 18%, 19% year-over-year.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱客戶多要求提前 52 週下採購單，FY27 大部分已在長約下，FY28 部分、FY29 更少
items.quote: I think the vast majority of calendar or fiscal year '27 is
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明長約承諾基本量低於客戶需求，上行部分價格不同
items.quote: we commit to a certain base volume, which is typically less
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱 HDD 僅佔超大規模業者 capex 的 4%-5%，但為關鍵元件
items.quote: there is no AI without HDDs
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱 HAMR 正與 4 家大型超大規模客戶認證，計畫 2027 年上半年開始出貨，Q1 少量、Q2 較多
items.quote: We're currently in qualification with 4 large hyperscale
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 重申 HAMR 出貨時程：2027 曆年上半年起，Q3、Q4 持續放量
items.quote: we intend to start shipping in the first half of calendar
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 被問及競爭對手已推出 HAMR，CFO 稱客戶已熟悉 HAMR，但認證流程保守嚴謹
items.quote: It definitely helps a little bit that we are not the first
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 40TB ePMR 上季少量出貨，本季開始放量
items.quote: we shipped a little bit last quarter. It will start ramping
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 高頻寬硬碟已向 5 家客戶送工程樣品，目標 2 倍效能，將搭配 50TB 以上機種
items.quote: We are now targeting a 2x improvement on the performance
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱客戶資料中心規劃超過 5 年，因此想鎖定長達 5 年的供給
items.quote: This is a planned economy.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱毛利率已達 50% 中段、營業利益率達 40% 中段
items.quote: we are now in the mid-50s with operating margins now in the
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱看不到毛利率天花板
items.quote: is there a ceiling to the gross margin?
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱長期每 TB 成本年降約 10%，但並非每年每季，目前處於產品轉換間且 DRAM/NAND 等投入成本上升
items.quote: we will be able to reduce cost per terabyte on or about 10%
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 提到硬碟內使用的 DRAM 與 NAND 變貴，供應鏈整體有輸入成本上升
items.quote: we use a little bit of DRAM and we use a little bit of NAND
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱近期毛利率仍將以相當快的速度提升
items.quote: gross margin will continue to increase at a pretty good pace
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱長期 capex 占營收 4%-6%，過去幾年低於此區間，未來幾年可能略高於
items.quote: the next couple of years, we might be actually slightly
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱 capex 主要投向讀寫頭、媒體碟片與自動化
items.quote: most of the CapEx spending goes to head and media as well
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱自由現金流率目標為 30% 以上，且已有數季達到該水準
items.quote: Our target free cash flow margin is plus 30%.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱已完成 SanDisk 持股變現、清理大部分債務，仍在處理可轉債，目前為淨現金
items.quote: We've completed the monetization of the SanDisk shares.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱剩餘可動用自由現金流全數回饋股東，以買回為主、股利為輔，並將持續調升股利
items.quote: The vast majority of the cash goes to the share buyback
items.speaker: CFO
